name: homePos
meaning: spawn position (Init; msg 9 arg 1); Reset returns here when IN_WORLD

name: state
meaning: UmbrellaState: 0 closed, 1 opening on the ground, 2 opening in the air, 3 open, 4 closing

name: umbrellaFlags
meaning: bit 0 = open (set when an opening anim ends, cleared by msg 0x16, Reset and Init); gates the msg 0x10 animation switch
